test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?)and complete the pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b50226d0dd3b154847d03e89344b5cd33cc25a8781f48927e8a2d0a64486879.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

First row elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise.

The top left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1316fde3d1875b485a827554c3f85d46aa87f47609c2e190249a299fb5615ad.png] 

2) Second box series →

The bottom row elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

The bottom left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3534bedf9f1de2a345c8ccaaaa15e4e6499cd90cf43a37a43dd4dee1070a09da.png] 

Thus, final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a77f65ae7e4a33e7c45f5a32dc3825c0f7dafcd231246068c697cf64a3aeef41.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
